sub_left: A chalk wall for drawings, messages, fan art and covers
empty: Nothing on the wall yet. Yours can be the first.
form_text: Draw or write on the board, add your name and send it. You can also share a link to fan art, a cover or a clip. Everything is checked before it goes on the wall.
rules: For fan art, covers and clips: post it on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube first, then send the link.
Only send work you made or have permission to share.
Nothing hateful, nothing that isn’t about Miles.
thanks: Thanks. It will show on the wall once it has been checked.
